_about: TRANSLATOR SHELF: Sir Edwin Arnold (1832-1904). The Bhagavad Gita as 'The Song Celestial' (1885). Since round 78 also the Book of Good Counsels (the Hitopadesa, 1861; in _pending since round 103, the only scan being a 1994 library photocopy), Indian Poetry with the Gita Govinda (an undated impression), Indian Idylls from the Mahabharata (1883) and The Secret of Death (the Katha Upanishad, 1885). PD. His own Light of Asia is an original poem, not a translation. Added 2026-10-03 by lane C (round 6) under the coordinator's standing instruction to choose further translator shelves; Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted in the relay burst.

arnold-indian-idylls: Indian Idylls, from the Sanskrit of the Mahabharata (1883)
arnold-secret-of-death: The Secret of Death, from the Sanskrit, with some Collected Poems (1885)

edwin-arnold-indian-poetry.of: Jayadeva's Gita Govinda, two books of the Mahabharata, proverbs from the Hitopadesa, and other poems
edwin-arnold-indian-poetry.work: Indian Poetry, containing 'The Indian Song of Songs' from the Sanskrit of the Gita Govinda of Jayadeva
edwin-arnold-indian-poetry.scan_edition: Project Gutenberg 25965 (clean text), from the 'eighth impression' of Kegan Paul, Trench, Trübner & Co. Ltd, Dryden House, London, which is undated
edwin-arnold-indian-poetry.note: The impression Gutenberg used carries no date, so it may be later than 1930; Arnold died in 1904, so the words are public domain either way. This falls under the late-reprint question in DIGEST-C.

edwin-arnold-indian-idylls.of: Episodes of the Mahabharata (Nala and Damayanti, Savitri and others)
edwin-arnold-indian-idylls.work: Indian Idylls, from the Sanskrit of the Mahabharata
edwin-arnold-indian-idylls.scan_edition: Trübner & Co., London 1883 (preface dated London, August 1883); University of Toronto scan

edwin-arnold-secret-of-death.work: The Secret of Death, from the Sanskrit, with some Collected Poems
edwin-arnold-secret-of-death.scan_edition: Roberts Brothers, Boston 1885; University of Toronto scan
edwin-arnold-secret-of-death.note: The Katha Upanishad in verse, followed by Arnold's own collected poems in the same volume.

_pending.edwin-arnold-book-of-good-counsels: Arnold's Book of Good Counsels (1861; cu31924074412994): the only scan found (IA cu31924074412994) is a Cornell University Library replacement volume (1994), a photocopy of the original on permanent paper, so it waits on the facsimile ruling. Found in round 103; it had been shelved before.

_excluded.light-of-asia: The Light of Asia (1879): Arnold's own poem.

_name_words_note: Translator name(s) only: fetch_shelf.py treats these as the identity check (one must appear in the fetched text), so the original author's name is deliberately NOT listed.
_verified_note: Evidence that each source's rights/identity line was read (lane C review fix, 2026-10-02, pipeline run over the fetched files; no book text recorded). PG: the header's Translator: line and the COPYRIGHTED marker. IA: whether the translator's name appears in the first 30 KB of OCR, and the years printed in the first 15 KB of front matter (scanner/digitizer lines skipped). Any post-1930 year there was examined by eye; see the title's scan_edition.
_surname_note: Full-name phrases, not the bare surname: the bare word ('rose', 'sale', 'lane', 'guest' ...) matches ordinary English (second review round, 2026-10-03).
